title: The Underbog
body: The Underbog lies beneath Serpent Lake in Coilfang Reservoir, a drowned cavern where the fungus of the marsh grows unchecked and the glowing caps give most of the light. Bog giants and shamblers wade its pools and underbats hang in the gloom. The naga hold part of it, crying out for Illidan, Murkblood Broken fight beside them, and the deepest pools hide worse than the bog giants.

parts.body: To the sporelings of Sporeggar the fungal giant Hungarfen is a leader of the spore giants they are at war with. It has tended the great plant called the Underspore to perfection for millennia.
sources: zones/underbog.txt (map 546: area 3716 only)

parts.body: The Black Stalker at the far end of the bog is the great mother of the marsh walkers, the sporelings' greatest danger through all their history, and Sporeggar cannot afford another attack from them.
sources: zones/underbog.txt (map 546: area 3716 only)

parts.body: With the great mother dead another of her brood will transform to replace her, but that takes time, and Sporeggar has some breathing room.
sources: zones/underbog.txt (map 546: area 3716 only)

title: Swamplord Musel'ek
body: Swamplord Musel'ek is a Broken who hunts for the naga in the Underbog, deadly with a bow and quick with a trap, with a great bear called Claw at his side. When the bear works itself into a frenzy he shouts at it to obey him and kill the intruders at once.

parts.body: Earthbinder Rayge of the Cenarion Expedition knows the truth: the swamplord can control animals, even druids. Windcaller Claw was caught in bear form and is now his pet.
sources: creature_template 17826 (faction 74, display 18570 BrokenMale); fixed spawn 138500, map 546 only

parts.body: Beaten down, the bear became Windcaller Claw again, a tauren druid, embarrassed to have been taken as a pet by a hunter.
sources: creature_template 17826 (faction 74, display 18570 BrokenMale); fixed spawn 138500, map 546 only
